name: io.github.ejackson-vp/throwbox
title: throwbox
description: Run one shell command in a disposable Linux box, paid in USDC over x402. No account.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Wallet that pays for sessions. Hex encoded, 0x plus 64 characters. Fund it with a small amount of USDC on Base, not more than you are willing to spend.

environmentVariables.name: CONFIRM_REAL_MONEY
environmentVariables.description: Must be exactly yes. The server refuses mainnet payments without it, so a pasted config cannot spend by accident.

environmentVariables.name: THROWBOX_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Service to buy from. Defaults to the hosted beta.

environmentVariables.name: THROWBOX_TIER
environmentVariables.description: Default session size: short, standard, extended or long. Defaults to short.
